_note: One real fight reading: Dark Bullet (Lv 136) plus the Nyxarchon pet's hit, round 1/10, on the monster below. Player stats at the time: snapshot_2 (ATK 511K, Dark Affinity 6.37K, DMG Boost 42.6%, Crit 22.9%/70.2%).
assumption: Larger number (368,285) = Dark Bullet, no crit (player-confirmed). Smaller = pet hit. Mantra of Blessings (DMG Bonus 21%) was active on the player.
decomposition: Player DMG Boost 42.6% + Mantra 21% = 63.6% (x1.636) against monster DMG RES 21.4% (x0.786) = x1.286. Net measured x0.981, so the remaining factor from monster DEF and the Affinity/Mastery ratio together is about x0.763.
use: Simulator: damage = (pct*ATK + flat) * 0.763 * (1 + DMGBoost) * (1 - 0.214) for non-crit on this monster; DMG Boost 42.6% already includes everything except Mantra (+21% when equipped). Crit multiplies by 1.702. Affinity/DEF changes are applied as ratios against the 0.763 residual.
